name: user-sets-simple
description: IXT-SUITES: My sets (save a selection as a reusable furniture set, pro). Hidden in Simple, present in Pro; selecting items + saveSelectionAsSet stores a named set, which deleteUserSet removes. Store-driven (UI is in the Arrange menu).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); localStorage.removeItem('hdb_user_sets') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-simple-hidden
steps.failMessage: userSets should be OFF in Simple mode

steps.name: assert-pro-on
steps.failMessage: userSets should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: assert-selected
steps.failMessage: selection of 2 items did not take

steps.name: assert-saved
steps.failMessage: saveSelectionAsSet did not store the set

steps.name: assert-deleted
steps.failMessage: deleteUserSet did not remove the set
